top_signals.title: Clean Hydrogen Investment Tops $130 Billion
top_signals.summary: The oil and gas supply shock amid the Middle East conflict has accelerated cumulative global investments in clean hydrogen to above $130 billion across more than 570 projects, as energy security has become a key driver of uptake alongside industrial growth and decarbonization targets, the Hydrogen Council said in a new report on Thursday. Total committed investment has topped $130 billion for 6.9 million tons per annum (mtpa) of capacity, the industry-led association said in its Global Hydrogen Compass 2026 report. top_signals.title: Iraq Tendering for Two Oil Supertankers to Go Through Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Iraq is holding a tender to hire two or more oil supertankers to perform transits through the Strait of Hormuz, a step that would help to ensure the country’s crude exports while the waterway remains under military threat.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: Schroders Plc is betting Hungary’s push toward euro adoption will deliver fast convergence-trade gains as the country’s government yields move toward those of peers already in the currency union.
